# Third-party material

| What | Where in the app | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Noto Emoji (monochrome emoji font) | `app/src/main/res/font/noto_emoji.ttf` | [google/fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notoemoji), Copyright 2013, 2022 Google | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`noto-emoji-OFL.txt`) |
| Nicomachean Ethics, tr. H. Rackham (1926) | quotations in `data/Quotes.kt` | [Perseus Digital Library](https://github.com/PerseusDL/canonical-greekLit) | Text CC BY-SA 4.0 (Perseus edition) |

The OFL allows the font to be bundled with software, including commercial software, as long as
the font itself isn't sold on its own and its licence travels with it. A copy is shipped inside the
app at `assets/licenses/noto-emoji-OFL.txt` and shown in Settings → About.
